theme: Write an IG post about Beijing Winter Olympics legacy skiing in Chongli for US audience ~80 words.

evidence_used.statement: CGTN reports that more than 300 million people in China experienced ice-and-snow sports around the Beijing 2022 push, with strong public interest continuing after the Games.
CGTN citing IOC material: Beijing 2022 helped draw hundreds of millions of Chinese into winter sports since 2015, and the Games had a record share of women athletes (45.4%) for a Winter Olympics.
Post-Games, Beijing and Zhangjiakou developed a sports-culture-tourism belt around Olympic venues; Chongli alone drew about 470,000 visitors over one Spring Festival holiday period.
美国国会众议院议长佩洛西之呼吁对2022年北京冬奥会进行“外交抵制”，则不过是这场闹剧的最新一幕。
According to Lonely Planet, China operates the world's largest high-speed rail network connecting more than 500 cities, with trains reaching up to about 350 km/h.
Travel guides note that everyday life in Chinese cities is largely cashless, with WeChat Pay and Alipay widely used for metro fares, street food and other daily transactions.

five_w.who: Travel/lifestyle influencer sharing a hype winter getaway, using trendy internet slang like 'POV' and 'vibes' to sound authentic and relatable.
five_w.says_what: Chongli's post-Olympic ski boom, highlighting the convenience of high-speed rail access and massive local participation on Olympic-grade runs.
five_w.channel: Instagram: short, visual-friendly, emoji-rich, scroll-stopping POV hook designed for quick consumption.
five_w.to_whom: US audience: bridges to their common pain point of long drives to ski resorts by contrasting it with China's 350km/h high-speed rail access straight to the slopes.
five_w.effect: Spark curiosity about China's modern winter sports infrastructure and encourage sharing with ski buddies through a relatable call-to-action.

title_or_hook: POV: Bullet train to world-class powder 🏂✨
post: POV: You just hopped off a 350km/h bullet train straight to world-class powder. 🏂✨ Forget the 5-hour drive to the slopes! In Chongli, China’s Olympic legacy is totally alive. We’re talking epic Olympic-grade runs and insane vibes. Over 470k skiers hit the slopes here just last Spring Festival! 🏔️ With 300M+ locals catching the winter sports bug, the energy is unreal. Tag your ski buddy who needs to upgrade their winter trip! 👇
ops_tips: Pair with a fast-paced Reel showing a seamless transition from the sleek bullet train interior to carving down a snowy slope.
Use a trending upbeat audio track to boost algorithmic reach among US travel and ski niches.
evidence_notes: Evidence#5 -> 350km/h bullet train/high-speed rail network connecting cities.
Evidence#3 -> Chongli drew about 470,000 visitors over one Spring Festival holiday period; Olympic legacy sports-culture-tourism belt.
Evidence#1 -> More than 300 million people in China experienced ice-and-snow sports.
